title: Robot Traffic Jam
learning_outcomes: Systems share context through the Property Twin
A safety guard can hold a scheduled action

steps.instruction: See where the simulated mower plans to work: the lawn around its dock.

instruction_layers.young: Find the lawn where the robot mower works.
instruction_layers.beginner: See where the simulated mower plans to work: the lawn around its dock.
instruction_layers.advanced: The mower's work area is 32 × 24 ft around its dock on the Property Twin (mowerWorkArea).
instruction_layers.teacher: Ask: why should a mower know where the animals are?

steps.instruction: Trigger the traffic jam: the Roaming Roost parks on the mower's lawn.

instruction_layers.young: The chickens' moving house drives onto the lawn!
instruction_layers.beginner: Trigger the traffic jam: the Roaming Roost parks on the mower's lawn.
instruction_layers.advanced: The roost's footprint now overlaps the mower's work area; workAreaOccupants() returns "Roaming Roost".
instruction_layers.teacher: Ask: what could go wrong if the mower ignored this?

instruction_layers.young: Time to mow! The mower wants to go.
instruction_layers.advanced: A start request reaches the interlock before any command is sent to the mower.
instruction_layers.teacher: Discuss: who decides - the mower's schedule or Tender Cells?

steps.instruction: Mowing is held: the lawn is not confirmed clear of animals.

instruction_layers.young: The mower waits. Chickens might be on the grass!
instruction_layers.beginner: Mowing is held: the lawn is not confirmed clear of animals.
instruction_layers.advanced: mowingBlockedReason() returns the occupancy reason; the start is refused and logged as an interlock event.
instruction_layers.teacher: Ask: why is waiting the safe choice?

steps.instruction: Trace schedule → zone → animal context → HOLD.

instruction_layers.beginner: Trace schedule → zone → animal context → HOLD.
instruction_layers.advanced: Engineer view: device → OS → signal (Property Twin) → rule → actuator (start refused) → notify.
instruction_layers.teacher: Have learners explain the hold to a younger student.

steps.instruction: Move the Roaming Roost off the lawn (simulated).

instruction_layers.young: Drive the moving house back to fresh grass.
instruction_layers.beginner: Move the Roaming Roost off the lawn (simulated).
instruction_layers.advanced: Run "Roaming Roost moves on": the roost returns to its spot and the work area is clear.
instruction_layers.teacher: Ask: is there another way to clear the conflict? (mow a different area)

steps.instruction: The mower can start only after the guard clears.

instruction_layers.young: The lawn is clear - the mower may go now.
instruction_layers.beginner: The mower can start only after the guard clears.
instruction_layers.advanced: The hold lifts when the interlock clears; the mower stays parked until it is started (no auto-resume by default).
instruction_layers.teacher: Check: can the learner name the two systems and the shared fact that connected them?
